title: Migrate Ledger to Aurora
description: Cut ledger-service over from Postgres Main to Aurora as agreed in ADR-007.

comments.author: person:ana-costa
comments.text: Cutover rehearsal for ledger-service is booked for Thursday.

comments.author: person:priya-raman
comments.text: ADR-007 was accepted because Postgres Main could not sustain Ledger write volume during month-end close. The Aurora cutover finished this morning.
